title: Compute Inhomogeneous Green's Function
action: Numerically solve the integral equation for the host medium's Green's function using the moment method for the two specified host configurations (σ_I=0.25 S/m, ε_I=2.0 and σ_I=0.5 S/m, ε_I=2.0). The free-space Green's function Γ0 is known analytically.
description: Offline computation of the host-aware kernel required for the forward operators in the inverse problem.

title: Load Provided Synthetic Scattered Field Data
action: The synthetic scattered field data for each host scenario (generated from a hidden defect) is provided as files. Load the data from `/app/inputs/synthetic_data_sigI0.25_SNR25.npz` and `/app/inputs/synthetic_data_sigI0.5_SNR25.npz`. These files contain the complex scattered field measurements at the receiver positions for the respective host medium. No further noise addition is required; the data already includes synthetic noise at SNR=25 dB.
description: Load the synthetic scattered field data that serves as the input for the inversion benchmarks.

title: Run IGA Inversion
action: For both host scenarios, run the genetic algorithm inversion using the inhomogeneous Green's function (IGA). Optimize the defect parameters (center coordinates, width, length, orientation) and the internal total field. Use GA settings: population size 20, mutation probability 0.4, maximum iterations 200. Record the estimated parameters, final cost function value, and number of iterations at convergence.
description: Core reproduction of the proposed inverse method.

title: Run FGA Inversion
action: For both host scenarios, run the same genetic algorithm but using the free-space Green's function (FGA) instead of the inhomogeneous kernel. All other parameters remain identical. Record the estimated parameters, final cost, and iteration count.
description: Baseline comparison method for evaluating convergence improvement.

title: Assemble and Export Reconstruction Results
action: Collect the reconstructed defect parameters, iteration counts, and final functional values from the IGA and FGA runs (steps 3 and 4) for both host scenarios and write them to a JSON file with the schema described in the output contract.
description: Final artifact containing all numerical results required for evaluation.
output_schema: JSON array of objects, each with fields: scenario (string, 'sigI0.25_SNR25' or 'sigI0.5_SNR25'), method (string, 'IGA' or 'FGA'), center_x (float), center_y (float), width (float), length (float), orientation (float), iterations (int), final_functional (float). Must contain exactly 4 entries: two scenarios × two methods.
